slides.title: Future continuous
slides.subtitle: Actions in progress in the future
goals: Describe what will be happening at a future time.
Ask politely about plans: *Will you be using the car?*

slides.title: Form and use

head: Example
rows: This time tomorrow I**'ll be flying** to Cancún.

list: Action in progress at a future moment: *At 8 p.m. I'll be having dinner.*
Polite questions about plans: *Will you be coming to the party?*

items.en: Don't call at 7. I'll be driving.
In ten years, people will be using flying cars. (prediction)
Will you be passing the supermarket? Could you buy some milk?

items.t: This time next week we ___ (lie) on a beach.
___ you be using the printer later?
